about.depth: During the spring migration anglers find them in roughly 30-70 ft (9-21 m)
about.behavior: Structure-oriented: found near buoys, pilings, platforms, debris, shipwrecks and artificial reefs, and with large animals such as rays, sharks and turtles. Cruise in packs of 3 to 100 during migrations in shallow water along the shore.
about.spawning: Spawns offshore many times through a long season
about.regulations_note: Cobia have separate Gulf and Atlantic stocks with different rules, and Florida's east coast is managed with the Atlantic. Check FWC and NOAA rules before keeping any.
